errors.source_contains_project: The upstream source cannot be a parent directory of this project.
errors.source_empty: Enter an upstream directory to scan.
errors.source_equals_project: The upstream source cannot be this project itself.
errors.source_nested_in_project: The upstream source cannot be inside this project.
errors.source_not_directory: That path exists but is not a directory.
errors.source_not_found: That directory could not be found.
errors.source_not_sibling: Choose an upstream directory next to this project.

ui.confirm_apply_hint: This copies the selected files from the upstream source into this project, overwriting local content for modified files.
ui.confirm_ignore_hint: This adds the selected files to the ignore list. They will be dimmed and unchecked in future scans.
ui.no_changes: No differing files between the upstream source and this project.
ui.project_only_hint: Exists only in this project. Never deleted by Reesync.
ui.scan_complete: Scan complete. Review the differences below before applying files
ui.scan_expired: That scan has expired. Scan the source directory again.
ui.scanning: Scanning the upstream and this project. Reesync is walking and comparing every file; this can take a moment for large checkouts.
ui.software_update_description: Selective upstream adoption: review every differing file against a local upstream checkout, then copy only the files you choose into this project.
ui.software_update_never_deletes: Project-only files are informational and are never deleted.
ui.source_changed: The upstream has a newer commit than this scan. Rescan before reviewing files.
